top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a quantitative prediction (the Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model, 2011) confirmed by the discovery of correlated insulators and superconductivity in magic-angle graphene (2018), independently reproduced and extended to a whole class of moire materials. The citation is limited to flat bands and the existence of correlated states, so the open pairing mechanism does not undermine it, and it opens a genuinely new regime of strongly correlated matter. I accept the real costs, namely maturity of about eight years and truncated experimental credit (Cao and others), and I rank P001, the mature and compactly credited lattice-clock prize, a close second; I would find it fully defensible. Any award is preferable to no award.
